statusDefinitions.implemented: Merged development capability, still subject to release proof
statusDefinitions.development: Implementation or hardening underway; open issue/PR
statusDefinitions.deferred: Explicitly outside 1.0; not a promised release/date
statusDefinitions.planned: Accepted outcome direction; detailed release scope not committed
statusDefinitions.provisional: Revalidate after earlier releases prove the architecture
statusDefinitions.demand-gated: Proceed only with demonstrated demand and capacity

notCommitted: LSP/semantic IDE features, terminal, Git UI, debugger/build system, AI sidebar
Generic plugin/theme marketplace or remote theme gallery
Minimap, code folding, hex editor, log tail, SSH/SFTP, global keybinding editor, Unicode inspector
Generic source-file Quick Look, Spotlight, Share/Services/Finder Sync extensions
More diagram languages or new Markdown syntax
ePub and hosted rendering are not committed; DOCX is only a later conditional publication candidate.
